name: contradictory-terminals
description: Two non-lost terminals for the same nonce — never sanctioned (design §6.2 per-nonce terminal uniqueness, TEP §10.4 rule 4's first-terminal-wins enforced at the source). The second terminal is rejected and flagged; the first terminal by seq wins and the flag persists (§6.4 row 'two non-lost terminals, one nonce').

events.displayMessage: A second, contradictory terminal for the same nonce — rejected at append

expected.note: seq 3 (first by seq) wins and stands as the recorded terminal; seq 4 is rejected+flagged, never a corrective replacement (it is not preceded by a `lost` terminal — contrast journals/rebuild-identity-style lost-then-corrective handling, which is the ONE sanctioned exception)
